     6|module
     7|
     8|public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Lattice.Image
     9|public import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.LinearOrder
    10|public import Mathlib.Order.MinMax
    11|
    12|/-!
    13|# Extra lemmas about intervals
    14|
    15|This file contains lemmas about intervals that cannot be included into
    16|`Mathlib/Order/Interval/Set/Basic.lean` because this would create an `import` cycle. Namely, lemmas
    17|in this file can use definitions from `Data.Set.Lattice`, including `Disjoint`.
    18|
    19|We consider various intersections and unions of half infinite intervals.
    20|-/
    21|
    22|public section
    23|
    24|
    25|universe u v w
    26|
    27|variable {ι : Sort u} {α : Type v} {β : Type w}
    28|
    29|open Set
    30|
    31|open OrderDual (toDual)
    32|
    33|namespace Set
    34|
    35|section Preorder
    36|
    37|variable [Preorder α] {a b c : α}
    38|
    39|@[to_dual (attr := simp) Ici_disjoint_Iio]
    40|theorem Iic_disjoint_Ioi (h : a ≤ b) : Disjoint (Iic a) (Ioi b) :=
    41|  disjoint_left.mpr fun _ ha hb => (h.trans_lt hb).not_ge ha
    42|
    43|@[to_dual (attr := simp) Ioi_disjoint_Iic]
    44|theorem Iio_disjoint_Ici (h : a ≤ b) : Disjoint (Iio a) (Ici b) :=
    45|  disjoint_left.mpr fun _ ha hb => (h.trans_lt' ha).not_ge hb
    46|
    47|@[simp]
    48|theorem Iic_disjoint_Ioc (h : a ≤ b) : Disjoint (Iic a) (Ioc b c) :=
    49|  (Iic_disjoint_Ioi h).mono le_rfl Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
    50|
    51|@[simp]
    52|theorem Ioc_disjoint_Ioc_of_le {d : α} (h : b ≤ c) : Disjoint (Ioc a b) (Ioc c d) :=
    53|  (Iic_disjoint_Ioc h).mono Ioc_subset_Iic_self le_rfl
    54|
    55|@[simp]
    56|theorem Ico_disjoint_Ico_same : Disjoint (Ico a b) (Ico b c) :=
    57|  disjoint_left.mpr fun _ hab hbc => hab.2.not_ge hbc.1
    58|
    59|@[to_dual (attr := simp) Iic_disjoint_Ici]
    60|theorem Ici_disjoint_Iic : Disjoint (Ici a) (Iic b) ↔ ¬a ≤ b := by
    61|  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Ici_inter_Iic, Icc_eq_empty_iff]
    62|
    63|@[simp]
    64|theorem Ioc_disjoint_Ioi (h : b ≤ c) : Disjoint (Ioc a b) (Ioi c) :=
    65|  disjoint_left.mpr (fun _ hx hy ↦ (hx.2.trans h).not_gt hy)
    66|
    67|theorem Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same : Disjoint (Ioc a b) (Ioi b) :=
    68|  Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl
    69|
    70|@[to_dual Iio_disjoint_Ioi_of_not_lt]
    71|theorem Ioi_disjoint_Iio_of_not_lt (h : ¬a < b) : Disjoint (Ioi a) (Iio b) :=
    72|  disjoint_left.mpr fun _ hx hy ↦ h (hx.trans hy)
    73|
    74|@[to_dual Iio_disjoint_Ioi_of_le]
    75|theorem Ioi_disjoint_Iio_of_le (h : a ≤ b) : Disjoint (Ioi b) (Iio a) :=
    76|  Ioi_disjoint_Iio_of_not_lt (not_lt_of_ge h)
    77|
    78|@[to_dual Iio_disjoint_Ioi_same]
    79|theorem Ioi_disjoint_Iio_same : Disjoint (Ioi a) (Iio a) :=
    80|  Ioi_disjoint_Iio_of_le le_rfl
    81|
    82|@[to_dual Iio_disjoint_Ioi_iff]
    83|theorem Ioi_disjoint_Iio_iff [DenselyOrdered α] : Disjoint (Ioi a) (Iio b) ↔ ¬a < b :=
    84|  ⟨fun h hab ↦ (exists_between hab).elim
    85|    fun _ hc ↦ h.notMem_of_mem_left hc.left hc.right,
    86|    Ioi_disjoint_Iio_of_not_lt⟩
    87|
    88|@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
    89|theorem iUnion_Iic : ⋃ a : α, Iic a = univ :=
    90|  iUnion_eq_univ_iff.2 fun x => ⟨x, self_mem_Iic⟩
    91|
    92|@[to_dual (attr := simp) iUnion_Icc_left]
    93|theorem iUnion_Icc_right (a : α) : ⋃ b, Icc a b = Ici a := by
    94|  simp only [← Ici_inter_Iic, ← inter_iUnion, iUnion_Iic, inter_univ]
    95|
    96|@[to_dual (attr := simp) iUnion_Ico_left]
    97|theorem iUnion_Ioc_right (a : α) : ⋃ b, Ioc a b = Ioi a := by
    98|  simp only [← Ioi_inter_Iic, ← inter_iUnion, iUnion_Iic, inter_univ]
    99|
   100|@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
   101|theorem iUnion_Iio [NoMaxOrder α] : ⋃ a : α, Iio a = univ :=
   102|  iUnion_eq_univ_iff.2 exists_gt
   103|
   104|@[to_dual (attr := simp) iUnion_Ioc_left]
   105|theorem iUnion_Ico_right [NoMaxOrder α] (a : α) : ⋃ b, Ico a b = Ici a := by
   106|  simp only [← Ici_inter_Iio, ← inter_iUnion, iUnion_Iio, inter_univ]
   107|
   108|@[to_dual (attr := simp) iUnion_Ioo_left]
   109|theorem iUnion_Ioo_right [NoMaxOrder α] (a : α) : ⋃ b, Ioo a b = Ioi a := by
   110|  simp only [← Ioi_inter_Iio, ← inter_iUnion, iUnion_Iio, inter_univ]
   111|
   112|end Preorder
   113|
   114|section LinearOrder
   115|
   116|variable [LinearOrder α] {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : α}
   117|
   118|@[simp]
   119|theorem Ico_disjoint_Ico : Disjoint (Ico a₁ a₂) (Ico b₁ b₂) ↔ min a₂ b₂ ≤ max a₁ b₁ := by
   120|  simp_rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Ico_inter_Ico, Ico_eq_empty_iff, not_lt]
   121|
   122|@[simp]
   123|theorem Ioc_disjoint_Ioc : Disjoint (Ioc a₁ a₂) (Ioc b₁ b₂) ↔ min a₂ b₂ ≤ max a₁ b₁ := by
   124|  have h : _ ↔ min (toDual a₁) (toDual b₁) ≤ max (toDual a₂) (toDual b₂) := Ico_disjoint_Ico
   125|  simpa only [Ico_toDual] using h
   126|
   127|@[simp]
   128|theorem Ioo_disjoint_Ioo [DenselyOrdered α] :
   129|    Disjoint (Set.Ioo a₁ a₂) (Set.Ioo b₁ b₂) ↔ min a₂ b₂ ≤ max a₁ b₁ := by
   130|  simp_rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Ioo_inter_Ioo, Ioo_eq_empty_iff, not_lt]
   131|
   132|/-- If two half-open intervals are disjoint and the endpoint of one lies in the other,
   133|  then it must be equal to the endpoint of the other. -/
   134|theorem eq_of_Ico_disjoint {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : α} (h : Disjoint (Ico x₁ x₂) (Ico y₁ y₂)) (hx : x₁ < x₂)
   135|    (h2 : x₂ ∈ Ico y₁ y₂) : y₁ = x₂ := by
   136|  rw [Ico_disjoint_Ico, min_eq_left (le_of_lt h2.2), le_max_iff] at h
   137|  apply le_antisymm h2.1
   138|  exact h.elim (fun h => absurd hx (not_lt_of_ge h)) id
   139|
   140|@[simp]
   141|theorem iUnion_Ico_eq_Iio_self_iff {f : ι → α} {a : α} :
   142|    ⋃ i, Ico (f i) a = Iio a ↔ ∀ x < a, ∃ i, f i ≤ x := by
   143|  simp [← Ici_inter_Iio, ← iUnion_inter, subset_def]
   144|
   145|@[simp]
   146|theorem iUnion_Ioc_eq_Ioi_self_iff {f : ι → α} {a : α} :
   147|    ⋃ i, Ioc a (f i) = Ioi a ↔ ∀ x, a < x → ∃ i, x ≤ f i := by
   148|  simp [← Ioi_inter_Iic, ← inter_iUnion, subset_def]
   149|
   150|@[simp]
   151|theorem biUnion_Ico_eq_Iio_self_iff {p : ι → Prop} {f : ∀ i, p i → α} {a : α} :
   152|    ⋃ (i) (hi : p i), Ico (f i hi) a = Iio a ↔ ∀ x < a, ∃ i hi, f i hi ≤ x := by
   153|  simp [← Ici_inter_Iio, ← iUnion_inter, subset_def]
   154|
   155|@[simp]
   156|theorem biUnion_Ioc_eq_Ioi_self_iff {p : ι → Prop} {f : ∀ i, p i → α} {a : α} :
   157|    ⋃ (i) (hi : p i), Ioc a (f i hi) = Ioi a ↔ ∀ x, a < x → ∃ i hi, x ≤ f i hi := by
   158|  simp [← Ioi_inter_Iic, ← inter_iUnion, subset_def]
   159|
   160|end LinearOrder
   161|
   162|end Set
   163|
   164|section UnionIxx
   165|
   166|variable [LinearOrder α] {s : Set α} {a : α} {f : ι → α}
   167|
   168|theorem IsGLB.biUnion_Ioi_eq (h : IsGLB s a) : ⋃ x ∈ s, Ioi x = Ioi a := by
   169|  refine (iUnion₂_subset fun x hx => ?_).antisymm fun x hx => ?_
   170|  · exact Ioi_subset_Ioi (h.1 hx)
   171|  · rcases h.exists_between hx with ⟨y, hys, _, hyx⟩
   172|    exact mem_biUnion hys hyx
   173|
   174|theorem IsGLB.iUnion_Ioi_eq (h : IsGLB (range f) a) : ⋃ x, Ioi (f x) = Ioi a :=
   175|  biUnion_range.symm.trans h.biUnion_Ioi_eq
   176|
   177|theorem IsLUB.biUnion_Iio_eq (h : IsLUB s a) : ⋃ x ∈ s, Iio x = Iio a :=
   178|  h.dual.biUnion_Ioi_eq
   179|
   180|theorem IsLUB.iUnion_Iio_eq (h : IsLUB (range f) a) : ⋃ x, Iio (f x) = Iio a :=
   181|  h.dual.iUnion_Ioi_eq
   182|
   183|theorem IsGLB.biUnion_Ici_eq_Ioi (a_glb : IsGLB s a) (a_notMem : a ∉ s) :
   184|    ⋃ x ∈ s, Ici x = Ioi a := by
   185|  refine (iUnion₂_subset fun x hx => ?_).antisymm fun x hx => ?_
   186|  · exact Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (a_glb.1 hx) fun h => (h ▸ a_notMem) hx)
   187|  · rcases a_glb.exists_between hx with ⟨y, hys, _, hyx⟩
   188|    rw [mem_iUnion₂]
   189|    exact ⟨y, hys, hyx.le⟩
   190|
   191|theorem IsGLB.biUnion_Ici_eq_Ici (a_glb : IsGLB s a) (a_mem : a ∈ s) :
   192|    ⋃ x ∈ s, Ici x = Ici a := by
   193|  refine (iUnion₂_subset fun x hx => ?_).antisymm fun x hx => ?_
   194|  · exact Ici_subset_Ici.mpr (mem_lowerBounds.mp a_glb.1 x hx)
   195|  · exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a, a_mem, hx⟩
   196|
   197|theorem IsLUB.biUnion_Iic_eq_Iio (a_lub : IsLUB s a) (a_notMem : a ∉ s) :
   198|    ⋃ x ∈ s, Iic x = Iio a :=
   199|  a_lub.dual.biUnion_Ici_eq_Ioi a_notMem
   200|
   201|theorem IsLUB.biUnion_Iic_eq_Iic (a_lub : IsLUB s a) (a_mem : a ∈ s) : ⋃ x ∈ s, Iic x = Iic a :=
   202|  a_lub.dual.biUnion_Ici_eq_Ici a_mem
   203|
   204|theorem iUnion_Ici_eq_Ioi_iInf {R : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder R] {f : ι → R}
   205|    (no_least_elem : ⨅ i, f i ∉ range f) : ⋃ i : ι, Ici (f i) = Ioi (⨅ i, f i) := by
   206|  simp only [← IsGLB.biUnion_Ici_eq_Ioi (@isGLB_iInf _ _ _ f) no_least_elem, mem_range,
   207|    iUnion_exists, iUnion_iUnion_eq']
   208|
   209|theorem iUnion_Iic_eq_Iio_iSup {R : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder R] {f : ι → R}
   210|    (no_greatest_elem : (⨆ i, f i) ∉ range f) : ⋃ i : ι, Iic (f i) = Iio (⨆ i, f i) :=
   211|  @iUnion_Ici_eq_Ioi_iInf ι (OrderDual R) _ f no_greatest_elem
   212|
   213|theorem iUnion_Ici_eq_Ici_iInf {R : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder R] {f : ι → R}
   214|    (has_least_elem : (⨅ i, f i) ∈ range f) : ⋃ i : ι, Ici (f i) = Ici (⨅ i, f i) := by
   215|  simp only [← IsGLB.biUnion_Ici_eq_Ici (@isGLB_iInf _ _ _ f) has_least_elem, mem_range,
   216|    iUnion_exists, iUnion_iUnion_eq']
   217|
   218|theorem iUnion_Iic_eq_Iic_iSup {R : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder R] {f : ι → R}
   219|    (has_greatest_elem : (⨆ i, f i) ∈ range f) : ⋃ i : ι, Iic (f i) = Iic (⨆ i, f i) :=
   220|  @iUnion_Ici_eq_Ici_iInf ι (OrderDual R) _ f has_greatest_elem
   221|
   222|theorem iUnion_Iio_eq_univ_iff : ⋃ i, Iio (f i) = univ ↔ (¬ BddAbove (range f)) := by
   223|  simp [not_bddAbove_iff, Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
   224|
   225|theorem iUnion_Iic_of_not_bddAbove_range (hf : ¬ BddAbove (range f)) : ⋃ i, Iic (f i) = univ := by
   226|  refine Set.eq_univ_of_subset ?_ (iUnion_Iio_eq_univ_iff.mpr hf)
   227|  gcongr
   228|  exact Iio_subset_Iic_self
   229|
   230|theorem iInter_Iic_eq_empty_iff : ⋂ i, Iic (f i) = ∅ ↔ ¬ BddBelow (range f) := by
   231|  simp [not_bddBelow_iff, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
   232|
   233|theorem iInter_Iio_of_not_bddBelow_range (hf : ¬ BddBelow (range f)) : ⋂ i, Iio (f i) = ∅ := by
   234|  refine eq_empty_of_subset_empty ?_
   235|  rw [← iInter_Iic_eq_empty_iff.mpr hf]
   236|  gcongr
   237|  exact Iio_subset_Iic_self
   238|
   239|end UnionIxx
